title: Thai-Style Prawn Ceviche
description: A refreshing and spicy Thai-inspired ceviche dish made with succulent prawns, perfect for a light meal or appetizer.

ingredients.name: saudi
ingredients.amount: 1-2 teaspoons Thai red chili paste (depending on desired spice level)

instructions: Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine the prawns, lime juice, red onion, cilantro, chili paste, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Mix well to combine and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with additional cilantro if desired and serve chilled.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
